results.title: Xiaomi Skynomad EREV SUV begins deliveries in China, CEO Lei Jun hands over keys to owners
results.description: Xiaomi's Skynomad lineup of EREV SUVs has begun deliveries in China, with pricing between 31,300 and 44,100 USD. The post Xiaomi Skynomad EREV SUV begins deliveries in China, CEO Lei Jun hands over keys to owners appeared first on CarNewsChina.com .
